model: PowerDNS Authoritative Server (gsqlite3 backend), primary for lab.openmap.test and 70.250.10.in-addr.arpa

capture.command: pdns_server --allow-axfr-ips=10.250.70.0/24 --disable-axfr=no on docker network fxlab-e (10.250.70.55); zones loaded with `pdnsutil load-zone`; TCP 53 published on 127.0.0.1:15355; the collector's own dnszone.Transfer ran through a byte-recording TCP proxy once per zone. No TSIG.
